shell_commands: find src scripts -name "*.test.ts" | xargs npm run test --
ls scripts/*.test.ts | xargs -n 1 npm run test --
for file in scripts/*.test.ts; do npm run test -- "$file" > /tmp/out.log 2>&1 || cat /tmp/out.log; done
grep -n 'validates a function-valued tool definition' src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts
grep -n 'throws at register time for an uncompilable schema naming the tool' src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts
git add src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md && git commit -m "fix: satisfy coverage and spec links for ToolRegistry validation"
git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main
git add src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts && git commit -m "fix: remove uncovered branch logic from registry validator errors" && git push origin HEAD
npm run eslint && npm run test:coverage -- src/orchestration/tools/
git add specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md && git commit -m "docs: repoint spec anchor" && git push origin HEAD
